evidence.quote: Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist

observations.why: Universal mandate framing — 'every new hire completes' — enacts authority-ranking by stipulating a uniform requirement imposed on all incoming members regardless of preference.

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page

observations.why: Stating that the checklist 'replaced' a prior system positions the new process as having superseded the old by institutional decision, invoking authority-ranking through displacement.
